1	# TOWER — Build Spec
2	**Air traffic control for coding agents.** BTW Buildathon 2026 · Track 02 (Graph Intelligence) · solo build, 6 hours.
3	
4	> Give this file to Claude Code as the source of truth. It is a specification, not code.
5	> Every contract below is deliberately pinned — do not redesign, do not add layers, do not
6	> generalise. If something here is wrong, fix it in one place and keep going.
7	
8	---
9	
10	## 0. One-paragraph statement of the product
11	
12	Multiple coding agents work the same repo in parallel (worktrees, background agents, CI agents) with
13	zero awareness of each other. Collisions surface hours later as merge conflicts or silently broken
14	callers. TOWER makes each agent **file a flight plan** before it edits: its prompt is resolved through
15	the Entire Graph into the set of symbols it will plausibly touch, and that set becomes a **lease**.
16	When a second agent tries to edit a symbol that is leased — or sits within `separation_depth` hops of
17	one on the call graph — TOWER **denies the edit through the agent's own permission hook** and returns
18	the first session's intent (recovered from its Entire Checkpoint) as a **handoff brief**, so the second
19	agent reroutes instead of clobbering. Every decision is logged to Databricks; the collision likelihood
20	shown in the deny message is computed there from historical co-change.
21	
22	**One sentence for judges:** *We don't resolve conflicts between agents. We maintain separation.*
23	
24	---
25	
26	## 1. Non-negotiable constraints
27	
28	| Constraint | Value |
29	|---|---|
30	| Language | Python 3.11+, stdlib-first. No frameworks beyond FastAPI + Streamlit. |
31	| Hook path latency | **< 800 ms end to end**, always. Fail-open on any error or timeout. |
32	| Network on hook path | **Never.** Databricks is read from a *local cache table* only. |
33	| Persistence | SQLite is the source of truth at runtime. Delta is the log + the analytics brain. |
34	| Entire calls | Only inside `tower/entire_adapter.py`. Nowhere else. Ever. |
35	| Config | `policy.yaml`, re-read on every request (cheap, and it is Curveball insurance). |
36	| Tests | pytest, must pass in fixture mode with no Entire and no Databricks. |
37	
38	---
39	
40	## 2. Repository layout (create exactly this)
41	
42	```
43	tower/
44	├── README.md
45	├── BUILDATHON.md            # submission doc, written at P7
46	├── NOTES.md                 # P1 recon: real Entire JSON shapes, pasted raw
47	├── policy.yaml
48	├── requirements.txt
49	├── .env.example             # DATABRICKS_* names only, never values
50	├── tower/
51	│   ├── __init__.py
52	│   ├── config.py            # policy.yaml + env loading
53	│   ├── models.py            # dataclasses / pydantic models
54	│   ├── entire_adapter.py    # THE ONLY place that shells out to `entire`
55	│   ├── store.py             # sqlite schema + all queries
56	│   ├── airspace.py          # lease building + separation algorithm (pure functions)
57	│   ├── prior.py             # collision prior: local cache read + refresh from Databricks
58	│   ├── briefing.py          # handoff brief: template first, FM API second
59	│   ├── sink.py              # background batched writer to Delta
60	│   └── daemon.py            # FastAPI app
61	├── hooks/
62	│   ├── tower_flightplan.py  # UserPromptSubmit
63	│   ├── tower_separation.py  # PreToolUse  (Edit|Write|MultiEdit)
64	│   └── tower_session.py     # SessionEnd  (release lease)
65	├── app/
66	│   ├── app.py               # Streamlit radar (deployed as a Databricks App)
67	│   ├── app.yaml
68	│   └── requirements.txt
69	├── notebooks/
70	│   ├── 01_bootstrap.sql     # catalog/schema/table DDL
71	│   └── 02_cochange.py       # builds the co-change prior
72	├── fixtures/                # written by P1 recon from REAL command output
73	├── scripts/
74	│   ├── recon.sh             # P1: capture real Entire output into fixtures/ + NOTES.md
75	│   ├── demo_up.sh           # start daemon + two worktrees
76	│   └── demo_reset.sh        # clear leases/squawks between rehearsals
77	└── tests/
78	    ├── test_airspace.py
79	    ├── test_adapter_fixture.py
80	    └── test_separation_e2e.py
81	```
82	
83	---
84	
85	## 3. Core data model
86	
87	### 3.1 Symbol identity
88	A **symbol_id** is `"<repo-relative-path>::<name>"`, e.g. `mux.go::Router.Match`.
89	If a target cannot be resolved to a named symbol (new file, YAML, markdown), use the
90	**file pseudo-symbol** `"<path>::*"`. File pseudo-symbols only ever collide at distance 0.
91	
92	### 3.2 SQLite (`~/.tower/tower.db`) — source of truth at runtime
93	
94	```sql
95	CREATE TABLE flights (
96	  session_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
97	  agent TEXT, repo TEXT, branch TEXT, worktree TEXT,
98	  prompt TEXT, intent TEXT,          -- intent = short summary of prompt
99	  filed_at REAL, last_seen REAL,
100	  status TEXT                        -- active | released | expired
101	);
102	
103	CREATE TABLE leases (
104	  lease_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,         -- uuid4 hex
105	  session_id TEXT, symbol_id TEXT,
106	  kind TEXT,                         -- core | halo
107	  hops INTEGER,                      -- 0 for core, 1..n for halo
108	  path TEXT,                         -- file path, for prior lookup
109	  created_at REAL, expires_at REAL, released_at REAL
110	);
111	CREATE INDEX idx_lease_symbol ON leases(symbol_id);
112	
113	CREATE TABLE squawks (
114	  squawk_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,        -- uuid4 hex, 4 digits shown in UI
115	  ts REAL, session_id TEXT,
116	  tool TEXT, file_path TEXT, line INTEGER,
117	  target_symbol TEXT,
118	  decision TEXT,                     -- cleared | warned | denied
119	  score REAL, structural REAL, prior REAL, distance INTEGER,
120	  other_session_id TEXT, other_intent TEXT,
121	  path_json TEXT,                    -- the graph path proving the conflict
122	  latency_ms INTEGER,
123	  rerouted INTEGER DEFAULT 0         -- set to 1 when the denied session next edits elsewhere
124	);
125	
126	CREATE TABLE prior_cache (           -- refreshed FROM Databricks, read on hook path
127	  file_a TEXT, file_b TEXT, prior REAL, refreshed_at REAL,
128	  PRIMARY KEY (file_a, file_b)
129	);
130	
131	CREATE TABLE graph_cache (           -- memoises expensive adapter calls
132	  key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT, created_at REAL
133	);
134	
135	CREATE TABLE outbox (                -- rows waiting to go to Delta
136	  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
137	  table_name TEXT, payload_json TEXT, created_at REAL
138	);
139	```
140	
141	### 3.3 Delta (`workspace.tower.*`) — mirrors flights / leases / squawks, plus:
142	
143	```sql
144	cochange(file_a STRING, file_b STRING, pair_count INT, a_count INT, b_count INT, prior DOUBLE)
145	graph_symbols(symbol_id STRING, path STRING, name STRING, kind STRING)
146	graph_edges(src STRING, dst STRING, relation STRING)
147	```
148	
149	---
150	
151	## 4. `entire_adapter.py` — the only Entire surface
152	
153	**Why it exists:** the real CLI output shape is unknown until 09:15 on event day. Everything else in
154	the codebase is written against *these six functions*, never against Entire's JSON.
155	
156	```python
157	def search_symbols(prompt: str, top_k: int = 8) -> list[SymbolRef]
158	def symbol_at(file_path: str, line: int | None) -> SymbolRef | None
159	def impact_set(symbol_id: str, depth: int = 2) -> list[tuple[SymbolRef, int]]   # (symbol, hops)
160	def path_between(a: str, b: str, max_depth: int = 2) -> list[str] | None        # symbol_ids, a..b
161	def session_intent(session_id: str) -> str | None      # from Entire checkpoints
162	def export_graph(dest_dir: str) -> dict                # writes symbols.ndjson / edges.ndjson
163	```
164	
165	`SymbolRef = {symbol_id, path, name, line_start, line_end, kind}`
166	
167	Rules:
168	1. Each function shells out with `subprocess.run(..., timeout=cfg.adapter_timeout)` and parses JSON.
169	2. **Every function is wrapped in try/except and returns an empty/None result on failure.** No raising.
170	3. Results are memoised in `graph_cache` keyed by `sha1(cmd)`, TTL `cfg.cache_ttl_s` (600).
171	4. `TOWER_FIXTURES=1` makes every function read `fixtures/<fn>.json` instead of shelling out.
172	   All tests run in this mode. The radar demo can run in this mode if Entire misbehaves.
173	5. Candidate commands (VERIFY IN P1, then correct here and only here):
174	   - `entire graph search --query "<q>" --format json --top-k N`
175	   - `entire graph def --symbol <path:line> --json`
176	   - `entire graph impact --symbol <name> --depth N --json`
177	   - `entire graph neighbors --symbol <name> --direction both --depth N --json`
178	   - `entire graph symbols` / `entire graph edges`  (NDJSON on stdout)
179	   - `entire checkpoint list --json` and `entire checkpoint explain <id> --short`
180	
181	`path_between` is implemented **locally**, not by Entire: build an adjacency map once per repo from
182	`entire graph edges` (cached), then BFS to `max_depth`. This is faster and gives you the actual
183	path list to print in the deny message.
184	
185	---
186	
187	## 5. The separation algorithm (`airspace.py` — pure functions, unit tested)
188	
189	### 5.1 Filing a flight plan
190	```
191	seeds  = search_symbols(prompt, top_k=policy.seed_top_k)          # 8
192	core   = {s.symbol_id for s in seeds}
193	halo   = {}
194	for s in seeds:
195	    for sym, hops in impact_set(s.symbol_id, depth=policy.lease_depth):   # 2
196	        if sym.symbol_id not in core:
197	            halo[sym.symbol_id] = min(hops, halo.get(sym.symbol_id, 99))
198	store lease rows: core (hops=0) + halo (hops=n), expires_at = now + policy.lease_ttl_minutes*60
199	```
200	Cap the lease at `policy.max_lease_symbols` (400) — keep the lowest-hop symbols. A lease that covers
201	the whole repo is useless and slow.
202	
203	### 5.2 Checking an edit
204	```
205	target = symbol_at(file_path, line) or file_pseudo_symbol(file_path)
206	
207	for each active lease L of another session (not expired, not released):
208	    if target in L.core:                  distance = 0
209	    elif target in L.halo:                distance = L.halo[target]
210	    else:                                 distance = len(path_between(target, nearest core, depth)) - 1
211	                                          (None if no path within policy.separation_depth)
212	
213	structural = {0: 1.00, 1: 0.60, 2: 0.35}.get(distance, 0.0)
214	prior      = prior_cache lookup for (file(target), file(other core symbol)), default 0.0
215	score      = round(0.65*structural + 0.35*prior, 2)
216	
217	decision   = "denied"  if score >= policy.deny_threshold   (0.55)
218	             "warned"  if score >= policy.warn_threshold   (0.30)
219	             "cleared" otherwise
220	```
221	Take the **highest-scoring conflict** if several leases match. Ties break by earliest lease.
222	
223	> **Calibration note:** distance 0 with a co-change prior of 0.63 gives exactly **0.87** — the number
224	> in the pitch. Use `gorilla/mux` files that actually co-change so the demo number is real, not staged.
225	
226	### 5.3 Exemptions (always clear, checked first)
227	- Target path matches any `policy.exempt_globs` (`**/*.md`, `**/*.lock`, `.entire/**`, `tests/**`, `tower/**`)
228	- The editing session **owns** the lease (same `session_id`)
229	- No other active lease exists
230	- Anything at all went wrong → `cleared` (fail-open), logged with `decision="cleared"` and a reason
231	
232	---
233	
234	## 6. Hook contracts (exact — do not improvise)
235	
236	Hooks are **stdlib only** (`json`, `sys`, `urllib.request`), 1-second timeout, and they exit 0 on any
237	error. A broken venv must never wedge the user's agent.
238	
239	### 6.1 `hooks/tower_separation.py` — PreToolUse on `Edit|Write|MultiEdit`
240	Reads stdin JSON: `session_id`, `cwd`, `hook_event_name`, `tool_name`, `tool_input` (`.file_path`).
241	POSTs to `http://127.0.0.1:8765/separation`.
242	
243	**On deny — print exactly this and exit 0:**
244	```json
245	{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny",
246	"permissionDecisionReason":"<the handoff brief, plain text, <= 1500 chars>"}}
247	```
248	**On clear or warn — print nothing, exit 0.** (Do *not* return `"allow"`: that would bypass the
249	user's own permission prompts. A warn is logged and surfaced on the radar, not in the agent.)
250	
251	### 6.2 `hooks/tower_flightplan.py` — UserPromptSubmit
252	POSTs the prompt to `/flightplan`, then prints:
253	```json
254	{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"UserPromptSubmit",
255	"additionalContext":"TOWER: flight plan filed. You hold a lease on 23 symbols around Router.Match. 1 other session is active in this repo."}}
256	```
257	This is worth demo points: the agent visibly *knows* it is in controlled airspace.
258	
259	### 6.3 `hooks/tower_session.py` — SessionEnd → POST `/release`. Print nothing.
260	
261	### 6.4 `.claude/settings.json` registration
262	```json
263	{
264	  "hooks": {
265	    "UserPromptSubmit": [
266	      {"hooks": [{"type": "command", "command": "python3 $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/hooks/tower_flightplan.py", "timeout": 10}]}
267	    ],
268	    "PreToolUse": [
269	      {"matcher": "Edit|Write|MultiEdit",
270	       "hooks": [{"type": "command", "command": "python3 $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/hooks/tower_separation.py", "timeout": 10}]}
271	    ],
272	    "SessionEnd": [
273	      {"hooks": [{"type": "command", "command": "python3 $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/hooks/tower_session.py", "timeout": 10}]}
274	    ]
275	  }
276	}
277	```
278	Entire installs its own hooks in the same file. **Merge, never overwrite** — multiple hook commands
279	can sit on one event, they all run, and the most restrictive permission decision wins.
280	
281	---
282	
283	## 7. Daemon API (`127.0.0.1:8765`)
284	
285	| Method | Path | Body | Returns |
286	|---|---|---|---|
287	| POST | `/flightplan` | `session_id, agent, repo, branch, prompt, cwd` | `{lease_id, core, halo_count, others_active}` |
288	| POST | `/separation` | `session_id, tool, file_path, line?` | `{decision, score, reason, evidence}` |
289	| POST | `/release` | `session_id` | `{released: n}` |
290	| GET | `/state` | – | full radar payload (flights, leases, last 50 squawks) |
291	| GET | `/health` | – | `{ok, entire: bool, databricks: bool, fixtures: bool}` |
292	
293	Run with `uvicorn tower.daemon:app --port 8765`. Single process, no reload in demo mode.
294	
295	---
296	
297	## 8. `briefing.py` — the handoff brief
298	
299	The deny message is the product. Build it in two stages so the demo never depends on a network call.
300	
301	**Stage 1 (template, always available):**
302	```
303	⛔ DENIED — separation conflict
304	
305	  symbol        {target.name}            {target.path}:{lines}
306	  leased by     {other_session_short}    session started {t}, {n} turns
307	  their intent  "{other_intent}"
308	  graph path    {a} ← {b} ← {c}          depth {d}
309	  prior         P(collide) = {score}     co-changed {k}/{n} commits · databricks
310	
311	  handoff brief
312	  {two concrete options}
313	
314	  cleared alternatives: {up to 3 unleased symbols from your own lease}
315	```
316	
317	**Stage 2 (Foundation Model API, if it responds in < 2 s):** rewrite the `handoff brief` paragraph only.
318	System prompt: *"You are an air-traffic controller for coding agents. In at most 60 words, tell the
319	blocked agent what the other session is doing, why it conflicts, and give exactly two concrete options.
320	No preamble."* Cache per `(session, target)` so a retry is instant. Any failure → keep the template.
321	
322	---
323	
324	## 9. Databricks integration (`sink.py`, `prior.py`)
325	
326	- **Write path:** hooks and daemon append rows to `outbox`. A daemon background thread drains it every
327	  5 s over `databricks-sql-connector` with batched `INSERT INTO ... VALUES`. Failures are logged and
328	  retried; **nothing on the request path ever waits for this.**
329	- **Read path:** `prior.refresh()` runs at daemon start and every 10 minutes: one query against
330	  `workspace.tower.cochange`, results written into `prior_cache`. The hook path only reads SQLite.
331	- **Bulk:** after `entire graph symbols/edges`, upload the NDJSON to a volume and `COPY INTO` the
332	  `graph_symbols` / `graph_edges` tables (see DATABRICKS_SETUP.md §B3).
333	
334	---
335	
336	## 10. Radar (`app/app.py`, Streamlit on Databricks Apps)
337	
338	Single page, `st.autorefresh` every 5 s, four blocks top to bottom:
339	
340	1. **Header strip** — active flights, symbols leased, squawks today, **collisions averted** (big number).
341	2. **Active flights** — table: session (short id), agent, branch, intent, lease size, age.
342	3. **Squawk stream** — reverse chronological, colour by decision, one row per squawk.
343	4. **Drill-down** — select a squawk → target symbol, the graph path as `a ← b ← c`, structural vs
344	   prior contribution to the score, the brief that was returned.
345	
346	Data source: SQL warehouse. Add `TOWER_SOURCE=local` to read the SQLite file directly instead — that
347	is your demo insurance if the warehouse stalls.
348	
349	---
350	
351	## 11. `policy.yaml` (Curveball insurance — express rules here, not in code)
352	
353	```yaml
354	separation_depth: 2          # max graph hops that still counts as a conflict
355	lease_depth: 2               # impact depth used when filing a flight plan
356	seed_top_k: 8
357	max_lease_symbols: 400
358	lease_ttl_minutes: 20
359	deny_threshold: 0.55
360	warn_threshold: 0.30
361	weights: {structural: 0.65, prior: 0.35}
362	exempt_globs: ["**/*.md", "**/*.lock", ".entire/**", "tests/**", "tower/**", "hooks/**"]
363	fail_open: true
364	adapter_timeout_s: 1.5
365	cache_ttl_s: 600
366	brief_model: databricks-claude-haiku-4-5      # confirm what your workspace actually lists
367	```
368	
369	---
370	
371	## 12. Acceptance criteria (this is the definition of done, phase by phase)
372	
373	| Phase | Done when |
374	|---|---|
375	| **P1 Recon** | `fixtures/*.json` contain **real** output from 4 graph commands; `NOTES.md` lists the actual field names; `entire_adapter.py` parses them; `pytest tests/test_adapter_fixture.py` passes. |
376	| **P2a Daemon** | `curl -XPOST /separation` with a hand-written body returns a deny JSON. The hook script prints valid deny JSON when fed the same body on stdin. |
377	| **P2b Flight plan** | POSTing a prompt creates ≥ 20 lease rows in SQLite in < 3 s. |
378	| **P2c Separation** | Two real agent sessions in two worktrees: session B's `Edit` is **denied**, and the reason contains a real graph path and session A's real intent. **This is the product — do not proceed past it for any reason.** |
379	| **P3 Databricks** | `squawks` rows appear in `workspace.tower.squawks`; `prior_cache` is non-empty; the deny message shows a prior that came from Databricks. |
380	| **P4 Freeze** | `git tag pre-noon-stable` pushed; `STATE.md` + `HANDOFF.md` committed; tests green. |
381	| **P5 Curveball** | Impact assessment captured *before* editing; constraint implemented; `git diff pre-noon-stable..HEAD` is explainable in 30 s. |
382	| **P6 Radar** | App URL loads, shows the averted-collision count, drill-down renders a real graph path. GIF of the deny recorded. |
383	| **P7 Ship** | BUILDATHON.md complete, final SHA noted, mirror pushed with checkpoint links, two clean rehearsals. |
384	
385	---
386	
387	## 13. Explicit non-goals (say no to all of these)
388	
389	- No auth, no multi-user, no accounts, no Docker, no CI, no migrations framework.
390	- No ORM. Raw `sqlite3` with parameterised SQL.
391	- No React. Streamlit only.
392	- No embeddings / vector search unless P1–P6 are all green and the clock says before 14:15.
393	- No git hooks (Entire owns those). No editing of files inside `.entire/`.
394	- No attempt to *auto-resolve* a conflict. TOWER denies and informs. That restraint is the product.
395	
396	---
397	
398	## 14. Failure modes to defend against (write the defence, don't just note it)
399	
400	| Failure | Required behaviour |
401	|---|---|
402	| `entire` not installed / command differs | Adapter returns empty → every check clears → agents work normally. Log once. |
403	| Graph call slow | 1.5 s subprocess timeout, cached results, deny path never exceeds 800 ms. |
404	| Daemon down | Hook's `urlopen` times out at 1 s → prints nothing → agent proceeds. |
405	| Databricks down | `prior = 0.0`, structural score alone still denies at distance 0 (0.65 ≥ 0.55). Radar switches to `TOWER_SOURCE=local`. |
406	| Two sessions, same worktree | `session_id` differs → still works. Leases are per session, not per branch. |
407	| Lease never released | TTL expiry sweep every 60 s in the daemon. |

1	# TOWER — architecture
2	
3	**Air traffic control for coding agents.** BTW Buildathon 2026 · Track 02 (Graph Intelligence) · solo, ~3h05m of coding.
4	
5	Authoritative plan: `TOWER_V2_NO_HOMEWORK.md`. It overrides `TOWER_BUILD_SPEC.md` wherever they disagree.
6	
7	---
8	
9	## Intent
10	
11	Multiple coding agents work one repo in parallel with zero awareness of each other. Collisions surface
12	hours later as merge conflicts or silently broken callers. TOWER makes each agent **file a flight plan**
13	before it edits: its prompt is resolved through the Entire Graph into the symbols it will plausibly
14	touch, and that set becomes a **lease**. A second agent editing inside or near that lease is **denied at
15	its own PreToolUse hook**, and the denial carries the first session's **intent** (from its Entire
16	Checkpoint) so it can reroute.
17	
18	*We don't resolve conflicts between agents. We maintain separation.*
19	
20	Prevention, not review. Call-graph space, not file space.
21	
22	---
23	
24	## Data flow — four phases
25	
26	1. **File** — `UserPromptSubmit`: prompt → `entire graph search` → `entire graph impact --depth 2` →
27	   lease rows (symbol, path, line_start, line_end, hops, via) written to SQLite. Slow work happens
28	   here, once per prompt, where a few seconds is invisible.
29	2. **Check** — `PreToolUse` on `Edit|Write|MultiEdit`: file path → SQL against *other* sessions'
30	   unexpired lease rows → lowest hops wins. Pure SQLite, no subprocess, no network.
31	3. **Decide** — score the conflict, write a squawk, and either print deny JSON or print nothing.
32	4. **Learn** — squawks drain from `outbox` to Delta out-of-band; the co-change prior flows back into
33	   `prior_cache` and sharpens the next decision.
34	
35	## Scoring — fixed, not to be "improved"
36	
37	```

49	
50	| Seam | Contract | Why it is a seam |
51	|---|---|---|
52	| **Adapter** | `search_symbols`, `symbol_at_file`, `impact_set`, `session_intent` in `tower/core.py` | Real Entire JSON shapes are unknown until recon. Everything else is written against these four functions, never against Entire's JSON. `TOWER_FIXTURES=1` swaps in `fixtures/`. |
53	| **Scoring** | pure functions over `(hops, prior)` | Unit-testable with no Entire and no Databricks. |
54	| **Policy** | `policy.yaml`, re-read per call | Curveball insurance. Thresholds, depths and exempt globs are config, not code. |
55	| **Sink** | `outbox` table | Delta is never on the request path. Databricks down ⇒ prior 0.0 ⇒ structural alone still denies at hops 0 (0.65 ≥ 0.55). |
56	
57	## What TOWER guards
58	
59	This repo: a fork of `entireio/entire-graph` (454 Go files, 1,334 commits), chosen because the
60	buildathon host designated it. TOWER is built inside the codebase it protects, so v2's line holds
61	literally — *"TOWER guards the repo it lives in."* Worth saying once in the demo: TOWER uses the
62	Entire Graph to protect the Entire Graph's own source.
63	
64	The vendored tree-sitter grammar C (`parser.c`, `scanner.c` — some blobs 30–54 MB) is already excluded
65	by the repo's own `.graphignore`, added upstream after those files produced `E_FILE_TOO_LARGE` /
66	`E_PARSE_ERROR` and a "degraded" graph. We inherit that fix. Do not remove it.
67	
68	**Stale in the spec:** `TOWER_BUILD_SPEC.md` §3.1 and §5.2 use `gorilla/mux` — for the `symbol_id`
69	example and for the co-change calibration that produces the 0.87 pitch number. Both references are
70	now wrong: the prior must be calibrated against *this* repo's history instead. The formula, the
71	weights and the thresholds are unchanged.
72	
73	## Rejected options (and why)
74	
75	- **FastAPI daemon on :8765** (spec §7) — deleted. ~45 min of work and the single most likely demo
76	  failure ("the daemon wasn't running"). Hooks talk to SQLite directly; WAL handles concurrency.
77	- **BFS + adjacency map + `path_between`** — deleted. `impact_set(depth=2)` already returns hop counts.
78	  Distance becomes a SQLite lookup, not a traversal. Store `via` so the deny message still prints a chain.
79	- **Subprocess on the hot path** — deleted. All graph work happens at flight-plan time. The check is ~5 ms.
80	- **Git worktrees** — deleted. Two terminals, one repo, identity from `session_id`. A same-tree
81	  collision is a more honest demo.
82	- **A second repo to guard** — deleted. TOWER guards the Entire fork it lives in.

85

"""TOWER_FIXTURES=1, isolated SQLite (see conftest.py) -- no Entire, no Databricks, no server.

Proves the scoring table pinned in CLAUDE.md / ARCHITECTURE.md:
  hops 0 + prior 0.63 -> 0.87 -> denied      hops 1 + prior 0 -> 0.39 -> warned
  hops 2 + prior 0 -> 0.23 -> cleared        own lease -> cleared      exempt glob -> cleared
"""

import time

import pytest

from tower import core


@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
def _clean_db():
    conn = core.get_connection()
    for table in ("leases", "flights", "prior_cache", "squawks", "outbox"):
        conn.execute(f"DELETE FROM {table}")
    conn.commit()
    yield


def _seed_lease(session_id, path, hops, symbol_id, via=None, prior=None, prior_other_file=None):
    conn = core.get_connection()
    now = time.time()
    conn.execute(
        "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO flights(session_id, agent, repo, branch, worktree, prompt, "
        "intent, filed_at, last_seen, status) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,'active')",
        (session_id, "claude", ".", "main", ".", "test prompt", "test", now, now),
    )
    conn.execute(
        "INSERT INTO leases(lease_id, session_id, symbol_id, kind, hops, path, line_start, "
        "line_end, via, created_at, expires_at, released_at) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,NULL)",
        (f"lease-{session_id}-{path}-{hops}", session_id, symbol_id,
         "core" if hops == 0 else "halo", hops, path, 1, 10, via, now, now + 1200),
    )
    conn.commit()
    if prior is not None:
        a, b = sorted((path, prior_other_file))
        conn.execute(
            "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO prior_cache(file_a, file_b, prior, refreshed_at) "
            "VALUES (?,?,?,?)",
            (a, b, prior, now),
        )
        conn.commit()


def test_hops0_with_calibrated_prior_denies_at_0_87():
    # spec's calibration note: distance 0 with a co-change prior of 0.63 must give exactly 0.87.
    _seed_lease("A", "fileX.go", hops=0, symbol_id="sym::fileX::Core",
                prior=0.63, prior_other_file="fileX.go")
    decision = core.check("B", "fileX.go")
    assert decision.hops == 0
    assert decision.score == 0.87
    assert decision.decision == "denied"


def test_hops1_warns_at_0_39():
    _seed_lease("A", "fileX.go", hops=0, symbol_id="sym::fileX::Core")
    _seed_lease("A", "fileY.go", hops=1, symbol_id="sym::fileY::Caller", via="sym::fileX::Core")
    decision = core.check("B", "fileY.go")
    assert decision.hops == 1
    assert decision.score == 0.39
    assert decision.decision == "warned"


def test_hops2_clears_at_0_23():
    _seed_lease("A", "fileX.go", hops=0, symbol_id="sym::fileX::Core")
    _seed_lease("A", "fileZ.go", hops=2, symbol_id="sym::fileZ::Distant", via="sym::fileX::Core")
    decision = core.check("B", "fileZ.go")
    assert decision.hops == 2
    assert decision.score == 0.23
    assert decision.decision == "cleared"


def test_own_lease_clears():
    _seed_lease("A", "fileX.go", hops=0, symbol_id="sym::fileX::Core")
    decision = core.check("A", "fileX.go")
    assert decision.decision == "cleared"
    assert decision.reason == "no-conflicting-lease"


def test_exempt_glob_clears():
    _seed_lease("A", "README.md", hops=0, symbol_id="sym::readme")
    decision = core.check("B", "README.md")
    assert decision.decision == "cleared"
    assert decision.reason.startswith("exempt:")


def test_no_other_active_lease_clears():
    decision = core.check("B", "untouched.go")
    assert decision.decision == "cleared"
    assert decision.reason == "no-conflicting-lease"


def test_search_symbols_parses_real_fixture_shape():
    seeds = core.search_symbols("semantic search over a repository", top_k=3)
    assert seeds, "fixtures/search.json should yield at least one leaseable symbol"
    first = seeds[0]
    assert first.symbol_id
    assert first.path
    assert first.line_start is not None and first.line_end is not None


def test_impact_set_reports_hops_from_depth_field():
    seed = core.SymbolRef(
        symbol_id="local/entire-graph:Go:internal/sem/search.go:function:SearchRepository",
        path="internal/sem/search.go", name="SearchRepository",
        line_start=683, line_end=690, kind="function",
    )
    halo = core.impact_set(seed, depth=2)
    assert halo, "fixtures/impact.json should yield caller/callee entries"
    assert all(hops in (1, 2) for _, hops in halo)


def test_render_deny_is_plain_text_no_network():
    _seed_lease("A", "fileX.go", hops=0, symbol_id="sym::fileX::Core",
                prior=0.63, prior_other_file="fileX.go")
    decision = core.check("B", "fileX.go")
    brief = core.render_deny(decision)
    assert "DENIED" in brief
    assert "sym::fileX::Core" in brief
    assert str(decision.score) in brief

        session_id = payload.get("session_id") or ""

        session_id = payload.get("session_id") or ""
        cwd = payload.get("cwd") or "."

            core.record_squawk(session_id, tool_name, file_path, None, decision)

                    "permissionDecisionReason": core.render_deny(decision)[:1500],

            }))

        # radar, not in the agent; only a deny bypasses the user's own permission prompt).
    except Exception:
        pass
    sys.exit(0)

# STATE — where a fresh session should start reading

Full plan: `TOWER_V2_NO_HOMEWORK.md` (overrides `TOWER_BUILD_SPEC.md`). Architecture: `ARCHITECTURE.md`.
Real CLI shapes: `NOTES.md`. This file is the fast path for someone (or something) joining mid-flight.

## Runbook rule that will silently break the demo if skipped

**`scripts/prewarm.sh` must run after EVERY commit, not once at the start of the day.** Proven this
session: a commit changes the tree hash, which invalidates Entire's committed-tree cache, which every
`--head --profile full` adapter call depends on. Without a fresh prewarm, the first `search`/`impact`
call after a commit pays the full cold-index cost again (17s-70s+ on this repo) against a hook timeout
that will kill it first — `tower_flightplan.py` then leases 0 symbols and (as of this session) says so
loudly instead of failing open silently.

**Specifically: prewarm must run after the 11:40 freeze commit and again after any Curveball commit,
before the noon demo / the Curveball session's first prompt.** Skipping this means the first flightplan
of that session silently (well — now loudly, but still) leases nothing, and TOWER protects nobody until
someone notices and re-runs it.

No `scripts/demo_up.sh`/`demo_reset.sh` exist yet (spec §2 lists them, not yet built this session) — if
one gets written, the prewarm step belongs at its start, before the first prompt is sent.

## Intent

TOWER makes a coding agent file a flight plan (prompt -> graph search + impact -> a lease of symbols)
before it edits, and denies a second agent's edit inside or near that lease at the PreToolUse hook,
carrying the first session's intent so the second agent reroutes. Prevention, not review; call-graph
space, not file space.

## Architecture in 10 lines

1. `tower/core.py` — one module: SQLite store + the only `entire` adapter surface + scoring. No server.
2. `hooks/tower_flightplan.py` (UserPromptSubmit) — `file_flight()`, prints lease size / warns if 0.
3. `hooks/tower_separation.py` (PreToolUse Edit|Write|MultiEdit) — `check()`, pure SQL, denies or
   prints nothing.
4. `hooks/tower_session.py` (SessionEnd) — releases this session's leases.
5. Leases store `hops` + `via` at flight-plan time (from `impact.callers/callees/type_consumers`
   entries' `depth` field) so the separation check never shells out (CUT 3).
6. Symbol identity is Entire's own compound `id`, not a hand-rolled `path::name`.
7. `score = 0.65*structural + 0.35*prior`; structural from hops {0:1.0, 1:0.6, 2:0.35}; prior from
   `prior_cache`, default 0.0 until Phase D.
8. Every adapter call is `--head --profile full` against a cache warmed once by `scripts/prewarm.sh`
   (see the runbook rule above) — never working-tree, never per-prompt cold.
9. Every hook wraps everything in try/except and always `sys.exit(0)` — fail-open everywhere.
10. `render_deny()` is a plain-text template, no LLM call, no network on the hot path.

## Done

- Recon (`NOTES.md`, `fixtures/`) — graph evidence #1, committed.
- `tower/core.py` + `tests/test_core.py` (9/9 passing, `TOWER_FIXTURES=1`, isolated DB via
  `TOWER_DB_PATH`) — committed.
- Three hooks + `.claude/settings.json` merge, proven end-to-end with piped fake payloads
  (flightplan leases real symbols; separation denies cross-session, clears same-session).

## Unresolved / open risks

1. **Measured latency floor on the separation hook: ~500-800ms, not the <200ms target.** Root cause
   isolated: bare `python.exe` process startup on this Windows machine is ~400-450ms by itself, before
   any TOWER code runs; `check()`'s own SQL logic is a small fraction of that. The 200ms budget is
   achievable for the logic, not for "spawn a fresh interpreter per PreToolUse call" — and the
   architecture that would fix it (a persistent process) is the daemon V2 explicitly cut. Not resolved,
   not silently accepted either — flagged for a decision.
2. Prewarm-after-every-commit (above) is a manual step with no automation or reminder besides this
   file and the prewarm.sh comment. Nothing currently stops someone from forgetting it.
3. `check()`'s hops=0 prior lookup is a same-file `(file, file)` key in `prior_cache` (spec §5.2's
   literal reading) — real co-change data never produces same-file pairs, so the 0.63->0.87
   calibration currently depends on staging that exact row by hand. Deferred to Phase D.
4. Real two-terminal, two-session proof (the actual C2 gate) has not yet run — only piped fake
   payloads have been verified.
